_comment: Source of truth for HTML_CATALOG.md. Edit this file, then run `npm run catalog`, then `npm test`. Stable ids never change. The catalog's size/store/marker/dependency columns and the parity check are computed by scripts/build_html_catalog.mjs and tests/html-catalog.js.

navigation.title: Customer journey (public)
navigation.body: `index.html` is the entry point. Customers search/filter the directory, open a venue and switch between Menu / Promos / Events / Gallery / About, then tap a WhatsApp order or reservation intent. `eatouts-suppliers.html`, `eatouts-blog.html` and `eatouts_feedback.html` are reached directly (or from About); `get-started.html` and `pricing.html` are the owner-facing marketing pages, and `one-pager.html`, `partner-terms.html` and `404.html` are static.

navigation.title: Operator back-office (restaurant owners)
navigation.body: From `index.html` → About Us → Operator Sign in (or demo login) the operator lands on `restaurant-dashboard.html`. The eight onboarding pages share one tab bar (Restaurant · Menu · Promos · Events · Gallery · Dashboard): `restaurant-onboarding.html`, `menu-onboarding.html`, `promo-onboarding.html`, `event-onboarding.html`, `gallery-onboarding.html`, `restaurant-dashboard.html`. The onboarding forms now publish for real — see "Onboarding & publish".

navigation.title: Universal sign-in â†’ role shells (staged package)
navigation.body: `eatouts-login.html` is the universal WhatsApp + PIN sign-in and routes by role: customer → `eatouts-profile/orders/favourites/addresses`, operator → `operator-dashboard1.html` (or the `*-manager.html` surfaces), admin → `eatouts-admin-dashboard.html`. `eatouts-business-signup.html` → the per-type onboarding form for that business type. Auth screens use the centred `.login` card; signed-in screens render a role-based shell via `EO.shell`.

navigation.title: Onboarding & publish
navigation.body: `eatouts-business-signup.html` sends each business type to its own form: `restaurant-onboarding.html`, `mobile-kitchen-onboarding.html`, `bottle-store-onboarding.html`, `caterer-onboarding.html`, `bakery-onboarding.html`, `supplier-onboarding.html` (lodge still uses `lodge-onboarding.html`). Every one of them shares `js/eatouts-onboarding-bridge.js`: live town/area lookup from `botswana_locations.js`, mall/shopping-centre lookup from `assets/data/botswana_shopping_malls_and_shopping_centres.js`, a Hosting Services section (capacity spaces + hostable event types from `assets/data/event_types.js` + booking rules) and a "Save & publish" action that writes the D1 business profile and the local customer directory, then exports an `eatouts.venue.v1` submission for the build-time merge. `operator-dashboard1.html`, `eatouts-staff-admin1.html` and `food-truck-schedule1.html` are the recovered `*1` workspaces.

navigation.title: Delivery flows
navigation.body: The customer app writes a draft order to `eatouts_order_v1`; `customer-delivery.html` collects delivery mode and, on 'sent on WhatsApp', persists a completed order into `eatouts_manager_v1.orders` (the order bridge). `restaurant-delivery.html` (dispatch board) and `driver-delivery.html` (rider board) are demo boards seeded from the Yellow Giraffe 50-order snapshot; the restaurant board persists to `eatouts_delivery_orders_v1`.

navigation.title: Internal ops & developer harness
navigation.body: `intake.html`, `invoice.html` and `ops-console.html` are auth-gated operator/ops tools over `eatouts_ops_v1`. `seed-demo.html` seeds the roster and runs data-layer verification; `eatout_event_builder.html` is a legacy experimental builder. Not end-user surfaces.

pages.purpose: Data-driven standalone venue About page: renders ANY resolved business's About surface (logo, hero, status, social row, Options, Operating Hours, Venue, Promos, Ambience, Amenities, Menu Tags) from the resolved business alone — no hardcoded venue values, section visibility driven only by present data.
pages.entry: Open directly; pick a business with ?link=<slug> (e.g. venue-about.html?link=nandos) or #<slug> (e.g. venue-about.html#nandos). No slug or an unresolvable slug hands straight back to the directory (location.replace('index.html#restaurants')) — there is no placeholder screen.
pages.interactions: Loads the shared modules (locations, brand, db, manager-db, users, seed, bridge, auth), the directory runtime data, the bottle/catering directories, and the page-scoped demo registry; seeds the bridge like index.html (EatoutsSeed.mergeDirectory + EatoutsBridge.setSource/ensureSeeded). Resolve order: demo registry → EatoutsBottleStores.get → EatoutsCatering.get → EatoutsBridge groups → /api/links/resolve. Social channels, Options rows, and the tabbar/Back button navigate into the SPA (index.html#..., index.html#<slug>/menu|promos, tel:, wa.me, maps). The Options accordion has four identifiable buttons (#optTown/#optArea/#optMenu/#optPromos): Town opens a floating town list (single town inline), Area a floating area list filtered to the chosen town (gated on a town being set), Menu/Promos open the venue's menu/promos or toast when absent. The logo overlay lightbox is available to everyone; its Settings accordion, colour editor, and drag handle are DOM-injected only when isOwnerOf(biz) is true.
pages.notes: Design/layout/behaviours derive from the preserved mockup (byte-identical to _trash/venue-about-demo.html), but every business value comes from the resolved business. No flagship fallback and no slug substitution. Owner detection is window.EatoutsAuth.currentSession() (restaurantId match) plus a manager-DB owner lookup. The page-scoped demo registry (assets/data/eatouts_demo_businesses.js) is loaded ONLY here and never merged into the customer DB, so index.html's browse list stays clean. Slug read order: ?link= → #hash; when neither resolves to a business the page redirects to index.html#restaurants instead of rendering an empty state.

changelog.note: One sign-in surface, a working password reset and the age policy. eatouts-login.html is now the only way in: WhatsApp number + username + password, all three, with a "Forgot password?" flow that mails a reset link (functions/api/_mail.js sends through Resend, or Brevo when that key is set; from EatOuts <info@eatouts.site>). The reset link lands back on eatouts-login.html?reset_token=..., the token lives 30 minutes and works once, and every other session for that account is signed out (migrations/0011_password_reset.sql). Every sign-in prompt in the app now points at that page with ?next= so people land back where they were; the About tab operator form was hardened to the same three credentials. Age policy: 10+ to hold an account, 18+ for the promos that sell alcohol - js/eatouts-age.js and functions/api/_promo-rules.js hold the same word list (tests/age-gate.js asserts they match), the venue bundle drops flagged promos for anyone under 18, the promos timeline shows a locked "18+ only" card, and the operator can flag any promo themselves (migrations/0012_promo_age_restriction.sql). eatouts_user_onboarding.html was retired (the caterer setup form now lives in caterer-onboarding.html) and the customer account page is eatouts-customer-signup.html. New suites: tests/login.js, tests/password-reset.js, tests/age-gate.js.

About tab guest card alert now offers three CTAs on a single row - Sign In (primary, eatouts-login.html), Sign Up (eatouts-customer-signup.html) and Later (dismiss); "Not Now" is gone and the row is styled to never wrap. The customer account page moved to eatouts-customer-signup.html (the old hyphenated path 301s there) so eatouts_user_onboarding.html could hold the caterer setup form; every customer sign-up entry point (login page, About guest popup, index.html guest feature popup, the unverified-user route in functions/api/auth/login.js) now points at the new page.

Onboarding pages now publish for real. The six business forms (restaurant, mobile kitchen, bottle store, caterer, bakery, event supplier) share js/eatouts-onboarding-bridge.js: live town/area lookup from botswana_locations.js, mall/shopping-centre lookup from assets/data/botswana_shopping_malls_and_shopping_centres.js, a Hosting Services section (capacity spaces + hostable event types from assets/data/event_types.js + booking rules) and a Save & publish action that writes the D1 business profile (business_profiles.hosting_json, new migration 0010) and the local customer directory, then exports an eatouts.venue.v1 submission for the build-time merge. business-onboarding1.html was retired — every link now points at the matching per-type form (assets/data/business_types.js gained EatoutsBusinessTypes.onboardingPage). eatouts_user_onboarding.html was rebuilt as the real customer account page (18+ gate, live town/area, /api/auth/signup + /api/auth/verify, favourites) and eatouts-user-onboarding.html is now a redirect. scripts/merge_submissions.py carries place/capacity/hosting into the runtime directory and rewrites directory_runtime_data.js; npm run build now merges the owner submissions after the directory build so they survive.

Brought the 2026-10 onboarding redesign pages up to the test contracts without touching the tests. Restored the `<!-- PAGE: X -->` banner and matching `<body data-page>` slug on all six: restaurant-, bottle-store-, caterer-, bakery-, mobile-kitchen-onboarding and eatouts_user_onboarding. restaurant-onboarding.html joined the app-shell standard: #app-shell renamed to #shell, brand mark wrapped in a home link to index.html#promos, hdr-chip page label, and the merchant tab strip (Restaurant active) — no appnav; it also now loads the upload libs (eatouts-image-compressor, eatouts-video-validator, eatouts-upload) ahead of its inline scripts, mirroring menu-onboarding. PAGE_INVENTORY.md gained section I (rows 69-71 for bakery/mobile-kitchen/user redesigns) and refreshed stale rows 28-30 (they are full editors now, not 3-line redirect wrappers). Catalog: added bakery-onboarding, mobile-kitchen-onboarding and eatouts_user_onboarding as ids 68-70 (operator-onboarding), and refreshed the stale 'Redirect wrapper' purposes on ids 10/19/20. npm test 52/52; npm run catalog 70 pages.

Venue About is now a true out-of-SPA hand-off. Every 'view a business' tap in index.html (openRestAbout from the card/info icon, bottleStoreInfo, openCateringAbout, and the boot-time openVenueFromSlug used by shared/SEO deep links) routes through a single gotoVenueAbout(target) → venue-about.html?link=<slug>, so a tap on KFC opens KFC's About page and Nando's opens Nando's. The inline data-page="venue-about" screen, its js/eatouts-venue-about.js renderer, state.venueAboutOrphan, and the orphan/catering/bottle/about branches of renderRestaurantSubView were removed. venue-about.html drops the 'Choose a business' empty state: a missing or unresolvable slug now redirects to index.html#restaurants. Its Menu/Promos options emit index.html#<slug>/menu|promos, which index.html boot parses back into the venue-menu / venue-promos screens. Deleted the root venue-about-new.html mockup and the js/eatouts-venue-about.js renderer. Updated tests/venue-about-menu.js (asserts the out-of-SPA target carries the chosen venue), venue-about-options.js (hash round-trip), beverages.js, bottle-stores.js and venue-slug-integration.js (boot hand-off target).

venue-about.html Options accordion: replaced the four generic class="opt" rows (Town/Area/View/View) with four identifiable, centre-aligned buttons (#optTown / #optArea / #optMenu / #optPromos, data-opt). Town opens a floating 'Select Town' popup (single town shown inline) built from every branch of the business (catering/bottle-store branches[] plus same-named restaurant-directory records, so chains like KFC/Nando's list all towns); Area opens a floating 'Select Area' popup filtered to the chosen town, gated behind a 'Select a Town first' toast when none is set. Menu/Promos navigate to index.html#<slug>/menu|promos, or toast '<name> has not yet loaded their menu' / 'has no promos available'. Menu availability read from directory_runtime_data menusRaw/menuFiles by canonical brand slug (the same source index.html uses). index.html boot now resolves #<slug>/menu|promos to the venue-menu / venue-promos screens. Added tests/venue-about-options.js (registered in run-all). npm test 51/51; npm run catalog 68 pages.

venue-about.html reworked again into a single data-driven page (the earlier EatoutsVenueAbout approach was dropped): every value now comes from the resolved business, section visibility is data-only (never type-based), and there is no flagship fallback. Resolution: page-scoped demo registry → EatoutsBottleStores → EatoutsCatering → EatoutsBridge groups → /api/links/resolve (4s abort). Owner-only Settings accordion/colour editor/drag handle are DOM-injected only when isOwnerOf(biz) (session restaurantId match, else manager-DB owner link). Loads the bottle/catering directories; the demo registry (assets/data/eatouts_demo_businesses.js, two demo rows) is loaded only here and kept out of the customer DB, so index.html's browse list is unaffected. Manager-db seed gains restaurantId on the demo businesses + a biz-truck/u-truck owner. Verified headlessly for restaurant/caterer/bottle/supplier/truck, owner and non-owner, plus empty-state and SPA-isolation checks. npm test 49/49; npm run catalog 68 pages.

Standalone venue-about.html rebuilt from a hardcoded Yellow Giraffe demo into a real top-level About page: it loads the same shared modules the SPA uses and renders the identical surface via window.EatoutsVenueAbout (renderRestaurantAbout / renderVenueNotFound), seeding the bridge from assets/data/restaurant_listings/directory_runtime_data.js with EatoutsSeed.mergeDirectory + EatoutsBridge.setSource/ensureSeeded. Slug contract: ?link=<slug> → #<slug> → flagship the-yellow-giraffe; venue actions link back into the SPA (index.html#<slug>, index.html#<slug>/menu). The old demo was preserved at _trash/venue-about-demo.html. index.html untouched. Catalogued as page #68; tests/inventory PASSED.

index.html About tab: the guest profile card and the signed-in profile card now open the About popups (from about-guest-popup.html / about-profile-options.html) instead of the guest card-alert and the signed-in .pc-rows accordion. Guest tap opens a .card-alert.pp explainer (4 feature options → per-feature explainer with Create Account → eatouts-user-onboarding.html; Sign In → eatouts-login.html; Not Now). Signed-in tap opens a .card-alert.fpop.pp shell (My Profile) with four list screens wired to real data — Favourites + Summaries read the EatoutsCustomer store; Orders + Gallery use placeholders (no customer store yet). Added renderAboutPopup/renderAboutPreview and helpers (aboutBack, aboutShell, aboutTile, aboutUser, aboutFavList, aboutSummaryList), scoped .about-*/.pp CSS, .pc-chev on the closed card, plus click/Escape dispatch and about-state reset on tab change. Updated tests/about.js and tests/customer.js. npm test 49/49.
Added about‑guest-popup.html and about‑profile‑options.html as new catalog entries.

Venue About page fix (index.html): the shared venue-about screen now correctly shows the specific venue (Nando's, KFC, caterers, bottle stores) instead of the flagship profile. The About icon (i) on each venue card navigates to that venue's About page. Reused state.restaurantView with a kind field (restaurant|catering|bottle_store) for unified routing. Added renderCateringAbout/renderBottleStoreAbout, venueAboutLocationRows/venueAboutOptions helpers. Updated openCateringAbout, bottleStoreInfo, openBottleMenu, pickCateringBranch/pickBottleBranch, viewKey. Extended tests/beverages.js and tests/bottle-stores.js with About navigation coverage. npm test 48/48.

Created HTML_CATALOG.md with a numbered master index, navigation map and per-page detail; generator (scripts/build_html_catalog.mjs) + guard test (tests/html-catalog.js) enforce that every root .html is catalogued.
Added brand-kit-admin, designer-dashboard, designer-services to catalog

Wired entry points: designer-dashboard reachable from designer-services.html, brand-kit-admin from eatouts-admin-dashboard.html; fixed brand-kit-admin login link; generator now prints the live catalogued-surface count.
Added customer account pages (eatouts-summaries, eatouts-events, eatouts-gallery, eatouts-checkout-summary) and public eatouts-about.html to catalog.
Renamed eatout-about.html to eatouts-about.html to match the customer-surface naming convention.

Full refresh: promo/event card icon rows and the promo-detail venue card in index.html; /bw/<slug> vanity links in index.html, eatouts-suppliers.html and eatouts-business-signup.html; business-links + promo-submissions admin on eatouts-admin-dashboard.html.
Redesigned 404.html: dependency-free rotating-headline layout in brand colours (brand-blue #2C6288 accent, black-2% #00000005 background) with the branded top bar + bottom nav.

index.html location pickers: all .fpop now fill 66px top / calc(66px+navh) bottom; 24px town labels, 18px transparent count badges, 20px area options; a vertical A–Z jump rail (scroll-spy + drag + bubble) on the promo, restaurant, bottle and reserve town pickers; "All Towns" rows centred; removed the "Picking one makes it active" note.

index.html bottle + restaurant filter bars: 12px top padding above the first row, 18px button labels, and All Areas centred between the left Town and right Type buttons; renamed the beverage type button to "Type" and the restaurant town button to "All Towns".

index.html Menu views: replaced the breadcrumb with a tappable Restaurant-Card (white, 4% black border, 90px logo tap-to-preview, name + tagline tap-to-About); removed the per-category heart; .phead h2 now 28px app-wide; enlarged the item thumbnail (54→90px), item/meta text and counters, moved the item heart to right:24px; added a bottom Back button to both views (new openRestAbout act).

index.html Menu categories + spacing: centred the .cat-row icon/text group (symmetrical 16px padding, .cat-row .minfo flex:none); slimmed the menu-view .phead (8px top/bottom, h2 margin-bottom 0); gave the Menu "Save Summary" pad 40px top / 4px bottom; tightened the two menu-view 24px separators to 10px.

index.html item labels + steppers: menu-view .ctr labels left-aligned with the price em at 20px (em.price); dropped the redundant item-name label from single-price size rows; enlarged the shared .stp stepper worldwide (buttons 50x45 @24px, .val 20px/min-width 44px, gap 8px).
index.html menu item price em: .menu-view .ctr .lbl em.price now bold black (#000, weight 800) on top of the 20px size.
Inactive heart: every img showing heart_inactive_icon.png renders at 50% opacity (index.html + eatout_event_builder.html) via img[src*="heart_inactive_icon"]; active heart/WhatsApp/Reserve untouched.

Page titles: every root .html now carries a <!-- PAGE: title --> banner after the doctype and <body data-page="slug">; every SPA screen carries a /* PAGE: id — title */ banner and is recorded at runtime as data-page/data-page-title on .screen (PAGE_TITLES map + page() helper). Added PAGE_INVENTORY.md and a read-only validator npm run inventory (scripts/update-inventory.mjs) plus tests/inventory.js.

Exact-page identity: renderViewport() now also writes data-page-ref (the live instance: venue/category/promo/store/photo id) onto .screen and <body>, via the new pageRef() resolver; added the read-only window.eoPage() console helper that prints a paste-ready one-liner. Validator + tests/inventory.js guard the new wiring; PAGE_INVENTORY.md FAQ documents it.

index.html Menu navigation: fixed stale state.menuCat leaking across venues (switching venue/tab could show a previous venue's category id, so venue-menu-item rendered "Category not found."). renderRestaurantSubView() now only opens the item page when the category exists in the active venue's menu (else falls back to the category list), and menuCat/menuOpen reset on nav Restaurants, toggleRestaurant, openRestView, openRestFromSearch, backFromRestView and openPromoVenue. Added tests/menu-nav-state.js.

Bottle menu (.screen[data-page="bottle-menu"]): all .bev-tile labels now use #8A7D63 (rgb(138,125,99)) to match the Drinks/Liquors headings, and tile borders use the same hue at 30% opacity instead of the per-category colour. Disabled (.off) tiles keep the dimmer #6f6553 label. tests/beverages.js asserts both computed colours.

Beverages navigation: added a bottom Back button to the store grid (data-page="bottle-menu") and a bottom "Back to Menu" button to the category page (data-page="bev-category"). The category back is hierarchical: bevOpenSub/bevOpenBucket now record the origin store on the view, and a new bevBack action returns to that store's Drinks/Liquors grid (or the filter results when the category was opened from search). tests/bottle-stores.js and tests/beverages.js cover both buttons.

Beverages category (data-page="bev-category"): when a category is opened from a store grid, the breadcrumb is replaced by that store's card (.restcard: logo tile + name + Liquor chain/store meta, tap = bevBack to the store grid); when opened from filter results (no origin store) the crumb is kept. Added press feedback to .bev-item rows and thumbnails (.bev-item:active / .bev-item .mthumb:active scale). tests/beverages.js asserts the store card replaces the crumb and the crumb fallback for search-opened categories.

Gallery full-photo view (data-page="gallery-photo"): dropped the breadcrumb (backAlbum) and the dots, and moved to an immersive full-screen photo — renderViewport() toggles #shell.gal-photo so the top header, control/filter bar and bottom nav hide while viewing; the image is sized to its content so the dark slide stays tappable around it, and tapping the backdrop (data-act="closePhoto") returns to the grid while tapping the image stays inert; the favourite + WhatsApp buttons are kept. tests/gallery.js updated.

Gallery full-photo view action row: the favourite + WhatsApp .ico-row split moved out of the bottom of the page and into every slide, directly under that photo (slide becomes a top-aligned column: 16px top offset, 14px gap, image capped at calc(100% - 78px)); the row now hugs the photo at any aspect ratio and travels with it while swiping. Vertical swipe, scroll-snap, backdrop dismiss and image-tap inertia are unchanged. tests/gallery.js asserts the row lives inside the slide.

Gallery full-photo view polish: the photo is inset 14px from both side edges (slide padding) so it is no longer edge-to-edge, and the favourite + WhatsApp pair is centred under it with a 36px gap (was split space-between across the full width, buttons near the screen edges). Photo height unchanged (~77% of the viewport). tests/gallery.js asserts the pair is centred and the CSS carries the gap + side padding.

Restaurant + bottle-store directory cards (data-page="restaurants-pager" and data-page="beverages") rebuilt to the menu-selector layout: each card now stacks four full-width rows (Town/City, Neighbourhood, Menu, Promos) above a centred icon row (favourite, WhatsApp, information). Rows are locked until a branch is chosen — single-branch brands auto-count as ready — and tapping a locked row opens a .card-alert explaining that every location has its own menu, with a primary button that jumps straight into the location picker (state.cardAlert, renderCardAlert(), data-locked/data-lock-* attributes + a dispatcher branch). The information icon (assets/icons/information-icon.svg, 50% opacity) leads to the venue-about page for restaurants and a store-details alert for bottle stores. The restaurant logo thumb is now a 54px rounded tile (tap still enlarges it via the existing preview). tests/restloc.js and tests/bottle-stores.js assert the five-row body, lock state and icon row.

About page (data-page="about-main") polish: the guest profile card is now an orange accent accordion — the secondary line is gone, the whole card is a centred 30px call-to-action that drops the stacked "Create an account"/"Sign in" rows, and opening it (as a signed-out browser) raises a .card-alert popup offering to navigate to the login page via openUniversalLogin (previously a guest tap hard-redirected). Settings rows (.setrow) bumped to 25px/1.35 for readability. The standalone "Share EatOuts" button was removed and the About social row's dead "Website — contact unavailable" slot replaced with a live Share_On icon that opens the WhatsApp share sheet; the unused .btn.share rule was dropped. tests/about.js covers the share icon and the guest accordion/popup.

About page guest profile card reworked from accordion to a focused sign-in popup: tapping "Create Profile" no longer drops the .pc-rows accordion (that block is now guarded to signed-in users only) and instead opens a centred .card-alert headed by the EatOuts logo, with a six-option vertical list (Favourites, Orders, Events, Saved Summaries, Profile, Gallery — each routing to eatouts-login.html) and Create an account (eatouts-user-onboarding.html) / Sign in / Not now actions. renderCardAlert gained optional a.logo, a.options[] and a.actions[] (href or data-act) while keeping the single-act locked-row alert path; .card-alert now scrolls if tall. tests/about.js asserts the popup content and that no accordion opens.

Removed the legacy Cloudflare R2 media path: deleted cloudflare-worker.js and js/eatouts-cloud.js and stripped the EatoutsCloud client from eatouts-blog.html (script tag + optional probe), js/eatouts-blog.js (feed fetch / cloud publish branches) and eatouts-suppliers.html (cloud hints, publish button, publishSupplier export path). Media now uses Supabase via /api/upload exclusively.

Customer-account fixes: EO.guard now requires a real session for role-gated areas, so a guest hitting a customer/manager page is redirected to login instead of being seated as the demo owner (js/eatouts-manager.js); eatouts-user-onboarding.html's offline fallback now stores a local password hash and EatoutsCustomer.login verifies locally-created accounts when the backend is unavailable (js/eatouts-customer.js). Legal privacy/terms data consolidated onto info@eatouts.site and eatouts.co.bw purged.

Business client wiring (Phase 2): new js/eatouts-business-api.js wraps /api/business/* (mine/claim/profile/staff/menu) with a dual-mode fetch client. staff-manager.html syncs memberships to D1, eatouts-business-signup.html claims via /api/business/claim and caches the D1 restaurant id, business-onboarding1.html's Save & publish PATCHes the live profile, and menu-onboarding.html reconciles its menu with the server. Tests: added tests/business-client.js, extended tests/router.js claim-bridge coverage.

Real media uploads (C4/C10 + E4/E5): js/eatouts-upload.js gained an opt-in server mode (uploadPrefix/uploadBlob/setUploadPrefix/sessionPrefix) that POSTs compressed images to /api/upload and stores the returned public URL, with a base64 data-URL fallback for offline/unauthenticated use. menu-onboarding, gallery-onboarding, restaurant-onboarding, promo-onboarding and event-onboarding now set a venues/<id> prefix before decorating. functions/api/upload.js hardened with a content-type allowlist (415) and 10 MB max size (413) plus a GET metadata endpoint. Tests: added tests/api-upload.js, extended tests/upload.js.

Real business sessions (D4): /api/auth/signup, verify and login are type-aware (customer|business); signup skips the 18+ gate for businesses, verify starts a session for the row's own type, and login accepts username-or-WhatsApp + password and routes business owners to eatouts-business-signup.html. New js/eatouts-business-auth.js calls signup+verify (or login), mirrors the D1 user into EatoutsMgrDB and starts the local session, with a local-account fallback when the backend is down. eatouts-business-signup.html's account step now collects a username + password (was demo PIN 1234) and creates a server account; eatouts-login.html's customer form makes the username optional so owners can sign in with WhatsApp + password. js/eatouts-customer.js bridgeLocal now mirrors the server user type/roles. Tests: added tests/api-auth-flow.js and tests/business-auth.js.

Business content endpoints (C6/C7): new /api/business/gallery (GET groups+images, POST groups, PATCH/DELETE groups/:id with image cascade, POST images, PATCH/DELETE images/:id) and /api/business/events (GET, POST, PATCH/DELETE events/:id) behind requireBusiness at marketing_manager+, with galleryGroupOut/galleryImageOut/eventOut mappers + jsonString/numOrNull helpers in functions/api/_business.js. js/eatouts-business-api.js gained gallery*/event* calls plus groupToServer/groupFromServer/imageToServer/imageFromServer and eventToServer/eventFromServer (extended event fields ride in the server `figure` JSON blob). gallery-onboarding.html and event-onboarding.html now reconcile their local stores with the server (push-on-change + push-missing-local + merge). Tests: extended tests/api-business.js and tests/business-client.js.

Business promos through the moderation queue (C8): migration 0006_promo_business.sql adds restaurant_id + source ('business'|'customer') to promo_submissions; promoSubmissionOut exposes both. functions/api/customer/promo-submissions.js now dual-serves: a body/query restaurantId routes to requireBusiness (marketing_manager+) and stamps source='business', otherwise requireCustomer as before; business promos always queue as status='pending' (never published directly). js/eatouts-business-api.js gained promosRead/promoSubmit/promoToSubmission. promo-onboarding.html submits on Save, reads back review status, and shows a review badge; the admin dashboard shows a Business/source pill and now labels the queue for events + business promos. Tests: extended tests/promo-submissions.js and tests/business-client.js.

Unified content model, public read (C9): new public GET /api/venues/:id (functions/api/venues/[id].js) resolves a venue by D1 id or slug and returns one canonical bundle — identity + visible menu categories/items, visible gallery groups/images, active promos and published events — reusing the _business.js row mappers. New js/eatouts-content.js (window.EatoutsContent) fetches that bundle, maps it to the v2 flat content shape and merges it into EatoutsDB (forkContent + contentSource='d1'), so every existing EatoutsBridge renderer shows D1-published content; it is conservative — a locally authored fork/flagship is never clobbered and an unreachable backend falls back to the imported directory. js/eatouts-bridge.js setActive now dispatches an 'eatouts:venue-active' event and index.html hydrates on venue open (plus the boot venue) and re-renders only when content applied. Tests: added tests/api-venues.js and tests/content.js.

About actions in index.html (openRestAbout, bottleStoreInfo, openCateringAbout, openVenueFromSlug) now navigate to the standalone venue-about.html?link=<slug> page instead of rendering an inline .screen[data-page=venue-about]. The inline renderer, EatoutsVenueAbout module and state.venueAboutOrphan were removed. venue-about.html replaces its history.back() handler with a 3-item Page-history popup (EatOuts Home / Restaurants / biz Menu). Tests updated to assert navigation target and absence of the inline about screen. venue-about-new.html mockup deleted; preserved copy in _trash/.
